summary: Repaired corrupted ANSWER prompt in toolset.py to remove task-specific leakage and syntax errors, replacing with general instruction to prioritize visual inspection over failed/ambiguous tool outputs.

edits.hypothesis: Replacing the corrupted, task-specific prompt with a clean, general instruction to treat tool failures and ambiguous negatives as non-definitive will prevent the agent from uncritically accepting false negatives without introducing benchmark-specific leakage.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The failure mode is behavioral (how the agent weighs conflicting/missing evidence), which is best addressed by adjusting the decision policy in the system prompt rather than changing control flow or tool wrappers. A clean prompt is required to fix the syntax error introduced in the previous round.
edits.trigger_condition: always (applies to all M5 tasks via the ANSWER constant used in agent_system)
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000001, the agent would have treated the roi_crop KeyError as missing evidence and relied more on its own visual inspection of the trachea. In q000002, the agent would have been skeptical of the two 'No' responses from VQA models, especially given the maira2 'not_applicable' status, and performed a more careful visual check. (preservative) The change adds skepticism but does not force tool use or break the habit of skipping tools for simple tasks (q000003). (transfer) Generalizes to any task where tools fail or return false negatives.
edits.regression_risk: May increase false positives if the agent becomes overly skeptical of correct negative findings, but the instruction emphasizes 'visual inspection' which should ground the decision.
edits.mechanism: Replacing the corrupted, task-specific prompt with a clean, general instruction to treat tool failures and ambiguous negatives as non-definitive will prevent the agent from uncritically accepting false negatives without introducing benchmark-specific leakage.
